title: Tinker Bell: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Tinker Bell wore a little red dress.
One morning, the flowers were not opening.
The firefly was trapped inside a spiderweb.
Glow saw a golden light near the river.
The little dragon was afraid of the dark.
Tinker Bell put fairy dust inside an empty cup.
What did Tinker Bell leave behind her every morning?
items.why: “Every morning, she flew over the forest, leaving sparkling fairy dust behind her.”

items.q: What would happen without the fairy light?
options: The forest would lose its magic
items.why: “Without the fairy light, the forest would lose its magic.”

items.q: Where did they find the dark cave?
items.why: “Behind the falling water, they discovered a dark cave.”

items.q: What does Tinker Bell say is the best magic?
items.why: "Sometimes, the best magic is simply being kind."

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: One morning, the fairy light was missing, and the forest began to lose its magic. Tinker Bell saved a firefly called Glow, and he helped her find the light in a dragon's cave. Tinker Bell gave the dragon a glowing seashell and took the fairy light back to the forest.

items.q: How did Tinker Bell know something was wrong in the forest?
items.model: The flowers were not opening, the butterflies were hiding, and the fairy lantern was dark.

items.q: Why didn't the dragon want them to take the crystal?
items.model: He was afraid of the dark.

items.q: How did Tinker Bell help the dragon?
items.model: She put sparkling fairy dust inside an empty seashell. The shell began to glow, and it became his own little night-light.

items.q: Tinker Bell says, "The best magic is simply being kind." Tell about a time someone was kind to you.

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: Tinker Bell saw that the fairy lantern was dark
Tinker Bell freed a firefly from a spiderweb
They found a dragon in a cave behind the waterfall
Tinker Bell made a night-light from a seashell
Golden light filled the trees again
